process.commandLine: bash -c 'set -u; command -v timeout >/dev/null || exit 1; echo SANDBOX_NETNS=$(readlink /proc/self/ns/net); timeout 5 bash -c "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/{{TARGET_IP}}/{{TARGET_PORT}}" >/dev/null 2>&1; result=$?; if [ "$result" = 0 ]; then echo NETWORK_LEAKED; exit 1; fi; if [ "$result" -ge 124 ]; then echo PROBE_FAILED; exit 1; fi; echo NETWORK_BLOCKED_OK'
